statusDefinitions.pending: No reviewer has established how this occurrence should be represented.
statusDefinitions.accepted: The reviewer confirmed that the source-faithful occurrence is intentional and that no unsupported executable meaning is claimed.
statusDefinitions.corrected: The reviewer confirmed a source or typed-field defect and linked its tested correction.
statusDefinitions.false-positive: The reviewer confirmed that the detector matched valid source content rather than a corpus defect.

formula.note: Reviewed as source-faithful dice notation. Typed dice fields are indexes where supported; this corpus does not claim a rules engine.

choice.note: Reviewed as source-faithful player or GM choice text. No inferred option automation is claimed.

scaling.note: Reviewed as source-faithful slot-scaling prose; scalesWithSlotLevel records only the presence of that printed section.

anomaly-candidates.note: The registered anomaly detector is a required CI gate; all remaining hits must be explicitly reviewed in extraction-overrides.json.

graph-shape.note: The graph gate expands every entity type, manifest, and bundle and rejects data loss or bare IRI-coerced strings.

provenance-exceptions.note: Only the local SRD source contributes retained assertions; the obsolete external creature cache has been removed.

table-shape.note: The fidelity gate rejects empty tables, promoted repeated headers, and source-span mismatches.

typed-source.note: The fidelity gate compares advertised spell, ability, magic-item, equipment, and attack fields with their local source spans.
